items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: I used to play with the Eureka, what is his name? Jim. Little Jim.

ctx.x: Who did you like out on the street in the brass band? Who were the best ones on the street?

Well, for bass drumming, he used to like that little short fella, I forgot what they called him, I used to play with the Eureka, what is his name? Jim. Little Jim. Little Jim. Couldn't see him while on bass drumming, did you know him? He's a little short fella, he's one of the best bass drummers, how he played parades.
Look at this song on the big bass drum, you couldn't see him behind the scenes. Yeah, I don't remember his name. He's a play drum, I'm telling you.
